caption: The drawing depicts a single hand tool centered on a plain, light beige background. The object has a wooden handle that is brown, cylindrical, and slightly tapered at each end, with visible grain and signs of wear. The handle is attached to a metal head by a metal collar fastened with two brass-colored rivets. The metal head is rusted brown and has an irregular shape: the left side is squared off with a slightly jagged lower edge, while the right side flares out with four evenly spaced, blunt, finger-like prongs. The middle portion of the metal is circular with a central hole and another smaller circular feature, possibly a bolt, near the top union of the handle and the head. The background is plain and unadorned, and just below the tool, there is faint text which reads "Edward Unger 1939," likely the artist's signature and date.
title: Cleaver
